old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-2hn1","title":"Allow multiple OSCORE Observe responses for one request PIV","description":"RFC 8613 Observe responses reuse the original request KID/PIV in AAD while each notification carries a fresh responder PIV.
